entry.author: Tauranga City Council
entry.summary:
A major milestone has been reached for Te Manawataki o Te Papa.
The new library and community hub has officially reached practical completion, making it the first new building completed within the civic precinct. Work now turns to fitting out the interior ahead of opening on 16 October, and we're inviting you in for an early look.
Join Senior Project Manager Sershin Iyer as he takes you on a walkthrough of some of the spaces that will soon become a place for our community to connect, learn, create and explore.
